products.name: Bambu Lab A1
products.shortDesc: A strong entry point into 3D printing — fast, accurate, and easy from day one, with multi-color printing via AMS Lite.
products.description: A strong entry point for anyone getting into 3D printing, with an easy, professional experience from day one. Combines speed, accuracy, and multi-color printing for gifts, models, logos, prototypes, and custom parts — suited to home, retail, or daily production use, with automatic calibration and AMS Lite support for up to 4 colors.

products.name: Bambu Lab A1 mini
products.shortDesc: A compact printer with serious capability — the same easy, fast Bambu Lab experience in a smaller footprint.
products.description: A compact printer with serious capability, for anyone who wants a smaller printer without giving up speed or quality. Delivers the same easy, fast Bambu Lab experience in a smaller footprint, with AMS Lite supporting up to 4 colors for finished, colorful prints without hand-painting — well suited to an office, home, or small-batch production.

products.name: Bambu Lab A2L (Pre-Order)
products.shortDesc: Large-format A-series printer — over double the A1's build volume, for bigger models and projects. Available for pre-order.
products.description: A large-format printer in the A series, built for bigger models, prototypes, decor, cosplay, and custom parts. Keeps the easy A1 experience but with a build volume over double the A1's, at high speed with multi-color support depending on configuration. Currently available for pre-order.
specs: AMS / AMS Lite depending on package

products.name: Bambu Lab P2S
products.shortDesc: Enclosed, fast printer built for daily production — consistency, speed, and easy operation.
products.description: An enclosed, fast printer built for daily production work — consistency, speed, and easy operation for products, gifts, prototypes, and repeat orders at high quality. Suited to workshops and retail use, with Combo options adding multi-color printing depending on package.
specs: AMS / AMS 2 Pro depending on package

products.name: Bambu Lab H2C
products.shortDesc: Professional-tier printer for higher output, more colors and materials, and larger projects.
products.description: A professional-tier printer for higher output, more colors and materials, and an advanced workflow suited to workshops, retail, and larger projects — built to take 3D printing from hobby to real production, with a large build volume, high speed, and higher temperatures for advanced materials.
specs: PLA / PETG / TPU / ABS / ASA / PA and similar

products.name: Creality SparkX i7
products.shortDesc: A smart, affordable way into 3D printing for beginners, students, and hobbyists.
products.description: A smart, affordable way into 3D printing — suited to models, gifts, prototypes, and custom parts without complicated setup. A solid starting point for home use, students, and hobbyists exploring custom products before scaling up to a higher-tier printer.

products.name: Elegoo Centauri Carbon 2
products.shortDesc: Enclosed CoreXY printer for speed, quality, and multi-color printing at a competitive price.
products.description: An enclosed CoreXY printer built for speed, quality, and multi-color printing at a competitive price — suited to projects, prototypes, custom products, models, and functional parts. The CANVAS system supports up to 4 filaments, with a hardened-steel nozzle rated for high temperatures and a practical build volume for most projects.
specs: PLA / PETG / TPU / ABS / ASA / PC / PA / PET / PLA-CF depending on settings

products.name: Flashforge Adventurer 5M
products.shortDesc: An easy starting point for beginners with fast, reliable results from day one.
products.description: An easy starting point for beginners with fast, reliable results from day one. CoreXY frame, automatic bed leveling, and a quick-swap nozzle make it suited to home, retail, or university projects, with a filament run-out sensor and power-loss recovery.
specs: PLA / PETG (TPU / PLA-CF / PETG-CF with the right settings)

products.name: Flashforge Creator 5 Pro
products.shortDesc: Professional multi-color, multi-material printing with 4 independent print heads.
products.description: A professional step up for multi-color, multi-material printing in a single project — 4 independent print heads, an enclosed heated chamber, and high speed for products, engineering models, multi-color figures, and mixed-material parts, with less waste than typical filament-swap systems.
specs: PLA / PETG / TPU / ABS / ASA plus CF/GF and advanced engineering materials depending on settings

products.name: Anycubic Kobra 3 Max
products.shortDesc: Large-format printer for big parts at a competitive price.
products.description: A large-format printer built for big parts at a competitive price — suited to oversized models, prototypes, and custom gifts. Multi-color printing available depending on package.

products.name: Snapmaker U1
products.shortDesc: Distinctive 4-head multi-color printer — faster, cleaner color changes than filament-swap systems.
products.description: A distinctive multi-head printer for faster, cleaner multi-color printing than typical filament-swap systems. The SnapSwap multi-head system opens up colorful products, models, logos, gifts, and creative parts with less waste — suited to content creators, retail, and serious hobbyists.
specs: Wi-Fi / USB / Snapmaker app depending on configuration

products.name: PLA Filament — 1kg
products.shortDesc: Everyday PLA filament for models, products, prototypes, and custom gifts.
products.description: Everyday PLA filament suited to models, products, prototypes, and custom gifts — easy to use, with clean results on most FDM printers.
